name: Society
overview: Scripture reveals that believers are called to live distinctively within society by being transformed through the renewing of their minds rather than conforming to worldly patterns. God’s presence empowers His people to serve Him faithfully, as seen in the promise of power from on high and the call to serve on His holy mountain. Christian conduct should reflect purity and integrity, avoiding the works of the flesh, and promoting unity by doing all things without grumbling or disputing. Each individual is encouraged to examine their own work, finding joy in faithful service rather than comparison with others.
